name: Elevator Structural Load
description: Load on the elevator guide rail bracket under emergency stop. Checks whether structural capacity is not exceeded.

elements.name: Peak Guide Rail Bracket Load
elements.description: Dynamic load during emergency braking. Uncertain due to payload variation and deceleration profile.

uncertainty.source: Dynamic simulation with payload and deceleration range

elements.name: Guide Rail Bracket Capacity
elements.description: EN 81-20 structural load capacity of the installed bracket

consistency_relations.upr_sigma: σ(F_bracket) = F_bracket if F_bracket <= F_bracket_cap, else ∅
consistency_relations.upr_description: The EN 81-20 structural capacity acts as guard; bracket loads above 25 kN are excluded from the consistent set.
